docs.text:
Transylvania in the seventeenth century: a young man's loyalty, a rival's revenge and a feud among the mountain nobles, by Hungary's great storyteller.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Mór Jókai (1825–1904), Erdély aranykora (Hungarian), 1851, translated by Robert Nisbet Bain (1854–1909), 1894. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
